purpose: Fixed zero-shot component checks before computing new-model predictions; retrospective datasets, not prospective experiments.
frozen_methods: ProteinMPNN v48_020 unconditional backbone log odds

datasets: PagP V104 scan with A104 experimental reference
stability.ranking: higher predicted compatibility or more favorable transfer is predicted stabilizing; no sign selection using outcomes
stability.exclusions: A reference; OmpLA P zero value unverified placeholder excluded, PagP P retained
stability.limits: Only two sites. Stability is a mechanistic auxiliary endpoint, never a channel-function improvement. OmpLA values inspected during source audit, no parameter fitting. PagP values subsequently inspected; no model tuning.

chrimson.controls: WT 66pA, tau_off 0.06s; E300G 305pA/0.19s; E300P 255pA/0.40s; E300V 0.22s; main-text values at study conditions
chrimson.utility: current gain with tau_off <= WT: both reported current-gain mutants fail; other kinetics not imputed
chrimson.input: PDB5ZIH deposited sequence, map author residue numbers via resolved coordinates, K176R applied. Surrogate input, exact experimental fusion construct not verified.
chrimson.ranking: P5 and ROC AUC among 15 patchable previously model-selected variants; no inference of enrichment vs random mutagenesis
chrimson.limits: Qualitative current-gain labels, no individual per-cell table supplied; only 2 positive mutations at same site; previously inspected successful mutations. Single ESM-1v member is not six-model consensus reproduction.

prior_panels: Any Bedbrook/Kir comparison is explicitly exploratory on already inspected tests, not a new independent confirmation.
